title: Batista2022: Motor-imagery EEG during NeuRow VR/haptics BCI training
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings, together with ECG, respiration, PPG and accelerometry signals, from 20 healthy volunteers performing cued left- versus right-hand motor imagery of a bimanual rowing task. Sessions compared Graz and NeuRow virtual-reality conditions with optional haptic and head-mounted-display feedback during brain-computer interface training. The data support research on BCI-based neurorehabilitation and motor imagery decoding.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 500 Hz from 32 active Ag/AgCl electrodes (actiCAP, LiveAmp 32, BrainVision Recorder) plus ECG, respiration and auxiliary channels. Each participant completed one session of up to five cue-based imagery runs (MI, MIMO, MIMOHP, MIMOVR, MIMOVRHP), each trial with a 5 s imagery/feedback window.
